call_budget.angle_calls: B only: one per accepted trial; canonical B = 4*N_a+32 each arm, Full B = observed accepted <=4*N_F+32
call_budget.event_requeries: one per B accepted trial; Full invokes original F3 event->packet; canonical original event(group,raw,child)
call_budget.packet_calls: Full original sample: one iff raw-valid, including coin reject; plus B angle requery iff accepted; frozen setup unchanged
call_budget.source_checks: shared file load/hash; per-pair setup; four sharing checks per pair; B overlay every operation; original F3 guards retained
call_budget.bound_semantics: exact scheduled sample count on success; variable path-dependent work counted, never force extra trials for coverage

schedule_policy.retention: all-trial compact exact-document hashes; full documents first 16/axis and failure context
schedule_policy.constructor: one per arm/layer/phase-pass; share X/Y after initial/X/Y/final state/source identity checks
schedule_policy.cache: no new law/packet/angle memo; frozen held state X/Y only; fresh process per pair; OS cache uncontrolled
schedule_policy.order: correctness then baseline then instrumented; fixed arm order, A then B; own fresh Linux fork child per pair
schedule_policy.angle: A ratio only; B every accepted event, no cache, Full original F3 requery and canonical audited requery
schedule_policy.memory: own child /proc/self RSS samples every 4096 trials and own HWM/final RSS; not continuous RSS peak
schedule_policy.output: unbuffered per-pair exclusive JSONL; exact hex rational payload, chain SHA and file SHA; no append
schedule_policy.flush: Python unbuffered flush, not fsync or power-failure durability
schedule_policy.overhead: coarse and fine exclusive partitions separately reconciled to outer child total; baseline replay separate
